scope: P1-A59 classic Zhong Hui, Quanji/Zili/Paiyi rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: BWIKI经典版本钟会（魏4体力，权计／自立，觉醒获得排异）

sources.use: 经典版本规则冻结：魏4体力；每受到1点伤害后可发动一次权计；权增加手牌上限；准备阶段权不少于3时自立；排异移去一张权，令一名角色摸两张，再按实时手牌数决定是否造成1点伤害。该页同时明确列出并隔离界限突破版本。
一将成名官方武将页用于交叉核对钟会身份、经典内容入口与574x761静态大图。
按用户指定概念页拆分技能元数据：权计由可选Trigger与持续手牌上限State组成；自立为必须执行且附带Locked/Limited的Awakening Trigger；排异通过应用ActionForms.Active表示出牌阶段操作入口。

ruleText.quanji: 当你受到1点伤害后，你可以摸一张牌并将一张手牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“权”（你的手牌上限增加“权”的数量）。
ruleText.zili: 觉醒技，准备阶段，若“权”的数量不小于3，你选择一项：回复1点体力；或摸两张牌。若如此做，你减1点体力上限，获得“排异”。
ruleText.paiyi: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以移去一张“权”，令一名角色摸两张牌，然后若该角色的手牌数大于你，你对其造成1点伤害。

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: private Quanji use/skip and exact hand-card storage, mandatory Zili branch and exact Paiyi Authority/target choices reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v107 keeps all Zhong Hui runtime effects disabled even when package 1.86.0 is loaded; package 1.85.0 does not register Zhong Hui

portrait.attribution: Official classic Zhong Hui artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: each point of damage opens one private Quanji use/skip window, then stores one exact hand card as a public Authority
Authority cards add to hand limit, are discarded on death and survive paused and completed replay reconstruction
Zili is mandatory once at three Authorities, resolves the chosen recover/draw benefit before reducing maximum HP, and acquires Paiyi once
Paiyi removes one exact Authority, lets any living target draw two, then compares current hand sizes before routing conditional damage through the normal damage chain
rules v107 and package 1.85.0 preserve both pre-Zhong-Hui boundaries
official portrait, structured skill types, private prompts, Authority badge and acquired Paiyi draft render without clipping or binding errors

excludedVariants: boundary-breakthrough Quanji that also triggers after another character obtains Zhong Hui's cards
boundary-breakthrough Zili that recovers and draws without a choice
boundary-breakthrough Paiyi with per-option limits and X-card or multi-target branches
god, scheme and other-product Zhong Hui definitions
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
